validity.researcher_notes: Existence/classification: this row is part of a large (~50-row), internally coherent family of GEM segments dated 2023-07-10 that maps onto SNGPL's known Sui-to-Peshawar trunk-and-branch system (Sui/Qadirpur -> Multan -> Sahiwal -> Faisalabad -> Lahore/Shahdara & Gujranwala/Gujrat/Jhelum -> Wah -> Peshawar), which matches real Pakistani geography and SNGPL's documented service footprint. Independent corroboration found: (1) Wikipedia's Sui Northern Gas Pipelines Limited article (verified live, url_verifier OK, contains 'Faisalabad' and 'Sui') states SNGPL's network has 'four main transmission regions: Faisalabad, Lahore, Multan, and Wah' -- confirming Faisalabad as a genuine, major SNGPL transmission hub, consistent with several GEM rows (P4128, P4129, P4135, P4136) radiating from it. (2) The GulfPub PE World Map (independent commercial pipeline atlas, not GEM-derived) has an operating, SNGPL-owned, 16in pipeline originating at Faisalabad (see spec entry) -- diameter, owner, status, and fuel all match GEM exactly, which is real independent existence support even though the exact terminus and length are uncertain. Caveats not resolved: no English-language source specifically names 'Faisalabad-Malakwal'; SNGPL's own website (sngpl.com.pk) has a 'Transmission Network Map' page but its content is not text-extractable via the tools available this session, and gem.wiki is blocked (403) for direct re-verification of whatever the wiki page itself cites. Classification (PipelineType=transmission, Fuel=Gas) is consistent with a hub-to-town trunk line of this length/diameter and with SNGPL's confirmed transmission-region structure -- no evidence of misclassification (e.g. as a gathering/feeder line). Duplicate check against the 63-row roster: P4129 (Faisalabad-Malakwal Gas Pipeline II, 30in, different diameter, same corridor) reads as a legitimate parallel/looped line rather than a duplicate of P4128, consistent with GEM's other I/II pairs on this roster (Sui-Multan I/II/III, Sidhnai-Faisalabad I/II, Sahiwal-Lahore I/II, Dandot-Gali Jagir-Wah I/II, Faisalabad-Shahdara I/II); GulfPub's own geometry also treats them as two distinct scraped records (7142 vs 7143), not one. No fills staged: Capacity is blank on the sheet and not tracked as a worklist unit for this row; GulfPub's record 7142 lists capacity 300.0 MMcf/d for its ambiguous Faisalabad match, but given the ambiguous P4128/P4135 match and the lack of any independently citable URL for that figure (GulfPub is a scraped dataset, not a web page I can run through url_verifier), it is not staged as a fill -- left blank per instructions rather than fabricated.

summary: P4128 (Faisalabad-Malakwal Gas Pipeline): existence/classification/owner confirmed with caveat via an independent GulfPub PE World Map match (16in/SNGPL/operating match GEM exactly) plus Wikipedia's SNGPL-transmission-hub corroboration for Faisalabad, but the GulfPub match itself is ambiguous (also fits P4135) and GEM's Length (158.67 km) disagrees ~15% with GulfPub's traced 138.4 km -- flagged as a spec concern, plus an internal length inconsistency vs sibling P4129 on the same corridor; no fills staged (Capacity lead unverifiable).
